zh-CN.title: 更清爽的锁定消息
items: 锁定消息页移除顶部栏和气泡旁的锁定者说明，保留完整聊天外观。
长按消息可在操作栏查看锁定者头像与人数，桌面悬停也可查看。

en.title: Cleaner locked messages
items: Locked messages keep their chat appearance without a header row or inline locker labels.
Long-press to see who locked a message above its actions, or hover on desktop.
